mediating.en: Sleep quality was found to be a mediating variable between job stress and employee turnover.
mediating.zh: 研究发现，睡眠质量是工作压力与员工流失之间的中介变量。

mediating.en: The mediating role of supervisor support cannot be ignored when explaining employee wellbeing.
mediating.zh: 在解释员工福祉时，主管支持所起的中介作用不可忽视。

mediating.en: Language ability plays a mediating role between education and employment outcomes.
mediating.zh: 语言能力在教育与就业结果之间起着中介作用。

moderating.en: Team size has a moderating effect on the relationship between training and productivity.
moderating.zh: 团队规模对培训与生产率之间的关系具有调节效应。

moderating.en: Prior experience played a moderating role in the link between training load and performance gains.
moderating.zh: 先前经验在训练负荷与成绩提升之间的关系中起到了调节作用。

moderating.en: The moderating influence of leadership support remained stable across three separate samples.
moderating.zh: 领导支持的调节影响在三个独立样本中保持稳定。

policy.en: The new policy aims to reduce waiting times in public hospitals nationwide.
policy.zh: 这项新政策旨在降低全国公立医院的候诊时间。

policy.en: Policy implementation often fails when local agencies lack adequate resources and authority.
policy.zh: 当地方机构缺乏足够的资源和权限时，政策执行往往失败。

policy.en: Economists debate whether the monetary policy stance will reduce inflation this year.
policy.zh: 经济学家们争论今年的货币政策立场是否会降低通货膨胀。

institutional.en: Institutional support strongly influences how new teachers adopt classroom practices.
institutional.zh: 制度支持对新教师如何采用课堂教学方式有着显著影响。

institutional.en: The study examines trust in institutional bodies across four European countries.
institutional.zh: 本研究考察了四个欧洲国家中人们对公共机构的信任。

institutional.en: Institutional investors shifted their portfolios after the market volatility last autumn.
institutional.zh: 去年秋季市场波动之后，机构投资者调整了他们的投资组合。

organizational.en: Organizational culture often resists change even when new technology is available.
organizational.zh: 即使有新技术可用，组织文化也常常抗拒变革。

organizational.en: The organizational structure of the firm was reorganized to improve communication.
organizational.zh: 该公司的组织结构经过重组，以改善沟通。

organizational.en: Managers reported that organizational commitment had declined noticeably over two years.
organizational.zh: 管理者报告说，员工的组织承诺在两年内明显下降。

societal.en: Societal attitudes toward migration have shifted considerably over the past decade.
societal.zh: 过去 10 年里，社会对移民的态度发生了很大变化。

societal.en: Technological innovation continues to reshape societal expectations of public services.
societal.zh: 技术创新持续重塑社会对公共服务的期待。

societal.en: The author argues that inequality produces deep societal costs for future generations.
societal.zh: 作者认为，不平等会给后代带来深刻的社会成本。

demographic.en: Demographic change has slowed population growth across most European regions.
demographic.zh: 人口结构变化减缓了欧洲大多数地区的人口增长。

demographic.en: The aging demographic presents serious challenges for pension systems worldwide.
demographic.zh: 老龄化人口对全球养老金体系构成了严峻挑战。

demographic.en: Marketing teams analyzed demographic data before entering the new market.
demographic.zh: 市场团队在进入新市场前分析了人口统计数据。

inclusion.en: The inclusion of rural schools in the reform program widened access to resources.
inclusion.zh: 将农村学校纳入改革计划扩大了资源获取的范围。

inclusion.en: Social inclusion remains a central goal of housing policy in many countries.
inclusion.zh: 社会包容仍然是许多国家住房政策的核心目标。

inclusion.en: The committee reviewed the inclusion of minority researchers in grant panels.
inclusion.zh: 该委员会审查了少数族裔研究者在科研资助评审小组中的纳入情况。

disproportionate.en: The reform had a disproportionate impact on low-income households across the country.
disproportionate.zh: 该改革对全国低收入家庭产生了不成比例的影响。

disproportionate.en: A disproportionate share of the funding was directed toward urban research centers.
disproportionate.zh: 城市研究中心获得了远超其比例的资金份额。

disproportionate.en: Regulators penalized the firm for its disproportionate treatment of part-time employees.
disproportionate.zh: 监管机构因该公司对兼职员工不成比例的差别对待而对其处以罚款。

inferential.en: The use of inferential statistics allows researchers to draw conclusions beyond the raw data.
inferential.zh: 推断统计使研究者能够超出原始数据本身得出结论。

inferential.en: Students often confuse descriptive reporting with inferential claims about causality.
inferential.zh: 学生常常把描述性报告与关于因果关系的推论混为一谈。

inferential.en: The paper uses inferential techniques to test whether the effect persists over time.
inferential.zh: 该论文运用推断技术检验这一效应是否随时间持续存在。

norm.en: Social norms strongly influence how individuals respond to environmental regulations.
norm.zh: 社会规范显著影响个人对环境法规的反应。

norm.en: The study compared professional norms across five different legal systems.
norm.zh: 该研究比较了五个不同法律体系下的专业规范。

norm.en: Such behavior violates the unwritten norm of academic honesty.
norm.zh: 此类行为违反了不成文的学术诚信规范。

solely.en: The delay was solely due to a shortage of laboratory equipment.
solely.zh: 延误完全是由于实验室设备短缺造成的。

solely.en: This measure should not be viewed as solely an economic intervention.
solely.zh: 不应仅仅把这项措施视为一种经济干预。

solely.en: The model was trained solely on data collected from European archives.
solely.zh: 该模型完全使用从欧洲档案馆收集的数据进行训练。

statistically.en: The correlation was statistically significant at the five percent level.
statistically.zh: 该相关关系在 5% 水平上具有统计显著性。

statistically.en: Statistically, the two groups did not differ on any measured outcome.
statistically.zh: 在统计意义上，两组在任何测量结果上都没有差异。

statistically.en: Differences between regions were statistically insignificant after controlling for income.
statistically.zh: 在控制收入变量后，地区之间的差异在统计上并不显著。

analytically.en: Analytically, the framework separates descriptive questions from causal ones.
analytically.zh: 在分析上，该框架把描述性问题与因果性问题区分开来。

analytically.en: The two approaches are analytically distinct, even if they share vocabulary.
analytically.zh: 这两种方法在分析上截然不同，尽管共享相同的术语。

analytically.en: This case is analytically useful for understanding how institutions respond to shocks.
analytically.zh: 这个案例在分析上对于理解机构如何应对冲击很有价值。

conceptually.en: Conceptually, the theory links individual choices to wider structural conditions.
conceptually.zh: 在概念上，该理论把个人选择与更宏观的结构条件联系起来。

conceptually.en: The reviewers found the argument conceptually sound but empirically untested.
conceptually.zh: 评审者认为该论证在概念上是合理的，但未经实证检验。

conceptually.en: Conceptually, classification and explanation require quite different kinds of evidence.
conceptually.zh: 在概念上，分类与解释需要相当不同类型的证据。

evidently.en: The protocol was, evidently, adapted from an earlier study.
evidently.zh: 该方案显然改编自一项早期研究。

evidently.en: The early results evidently exceeded the expectations of the research team.
evidently.zh: 早期结果显然超出了研究团队的预期。

evidently.en: Evidently, the training program did little to change daily practice.
evidently.zh: 显然，该培训项目对改变日常实践作用甚微。

ostensibly.en: The ostensibly neutral rule actually reinforced existing inequalities.
ostensibly.zh: 这条表面上中立的规则实际上强化了既有的不平等。

ostensibly.en: The reform was ostensibly designed to reduce administrative delays for citizens.
ostensibly.zh: 这项改革据称旨在减少公民办理事务时的行政延误。

ostensibly.en: Although ostensibly voluntary, the scheme was supported by subtle financial incentives.
ostensibly.zh: 尽管名义上是自愿的，该计划背后却有不易察觉的经济激励。

seemingly.en: The two variables that appear unrelated show a seemingly random pattern.
seemingly.zh: 这两个看似无关的变量呈现出一种看似随机的模式。

seemingly.en: The seemingly minor issue eventually became a major point of contention.
seemingly.zh: 看似微不足道的问题却演变成了主要的争论焦点。

seemingly.en: Participants often prefer the seemingly simpler explanation for complex findings.
seemingly.zh: 参与者往往偏好那种看似更简单、能够解释复杂结果的说明。
